name: @hivemoot/war-room
description: Shared war-room storage layer + redis-lock helper. Imported by web (HTTP route handlers) and bot (direct internal callers); not published to npm. The consumer's `@upstash/redis` install is reused by source-level resolution; this package intentionally declares no @upstash/redis dependency to avoid a dual-package hazard (two installations producing non-assignable Redis types).
